light-base: reuse the saved parachain runtime on warm start (#3416)

Fixes #3204
Supersedes #3214

## Problem

After a restart with a saved database, the parachain downloaded `:code`
again, even when the runtime hadn't changed.

## Changes

- Pass the database `:code` hint to the parachain sync service (no
database format change).
- At bootstrap, fetch the `:code` Merkle value first; use the saved
runtime if it matches, otherwise download `:code`.
- Drop the hint after a failed bootstrap attempt, so a corrupted saved
runtime falls back to a download.
- Rename `ConfigSubstrateCompatibleRuntimeCodeHint` to
`ConfigRuntimeCodeHint`, now used by both chain types.

- New e2e test `parachain_warm_start` (in zombienet CI): restarts the
